definitions.gloss: brown sugar; unrefined sugar; raw sugar
definitions.explanation: Dark, unrefined cane sugar with a rich, molasses-like flavor. A specialty product of Okinawa and other southern Japanese islands.

examples.japanese: {沖縄|おきなわ}の{黒砂糖|くろざとう}はおいしい。
{黒砂糖|くろざとう}を{使|つか}ったお{菓子|かし}が{人気|にんき}だ。
examples.english: Sweets made with brown sugar are popular.

examples.japanese: コーヒーに{白砂糖|しろざとう}ではなく{黒砂糖|くろざとう}を{入|い}れると、コクのある{味|あじ}になる。
examples.english: If you put brown sugar instead of white sugar in your coffee, it gives it a richer flavor.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {黒|くろ} (black/dark) + {砂糖|さとう} (sugar). Also shortened to {黒糖|こくとう}. Okinawan {黒砂糖|くろざとう} is a well-known regional product and is used in many traditional sweets and drinks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黒砂糖|くろざとう}を{使|つか}う (to use brown sugar)
- {沖縄|おきなわ}{産|さん}の{黒砂糖|くろざとう} (Okinawan brown sugar)
- {黒砂糖|くろざとう}{味|あじ} (brown sugar flavor)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {白砂糖|しろざとう}: white sugar — refined sugar
- {黒糖|こくとう}: brown sugar — a shorter, more common alternative name
- {角砂糖|かくざとう}: sugar cube — a different form of sugar
